facts.fact: ZIMSTAT lists quarterly Crime Statistics Reports, the newest for Q2 2026 published in November 2026, and says they are based on data from the Zimbabwe Republic Police Crime Report and Disposal System.
ZIMSTAT says its crime statistics reports draw on the Zimbabwe Republic Police Crime Report and Disposal System, aggregated to the ICCS classification.
ZIMSTAT's page lists six quarterly crime statistics reports from the police system, published between March 2025 and November 2026 (Q4 2024 to Q2 2026).
